response: Stay calm. Do not click anything in the popup and do not call the number. Tell me exactly what you see: is it inside a browser tab or a separate window? If it is a browser tab, close the tab or the browser without entering information. If closing it feels unclear, pause and ask a trusted helper before doing anything else.
action_plan: Tell them not to click or call.
Recommend a trusted helper if needed.
principles_used: Do not click or call scam prompts.
